messages:
omar_support: Heads-up — Customer (acct: acme-corp) opened a charge dispute. Invoice INV-2025-0421 shows $3,412.60 tied to 3,204,182 tokens. Their project dashboard for the same billing window (2025-04-01 00:00 to 2025-04-01 23:59 UTC) shows ~1,112,044 tokens. They say usage looks tripled on the invoice. Ticket SUP-7298 created.

eve_finance: Thanks for flagging. Customer requested a refund if we confirm overbilling. Please gather raw metering logs and any pipeline aggregation/ETL notes. If there's a correction, we'll need revrec adjustment and a credit memo.

maria_sre: Can you paste the customer project id and the invoice period? I want to check the ingestion pipeline and the meter-aggregator service (meter-agg v2). Past incidents had double-counting when chunked streaming + retry dedup failed.

omar_support: Project id: proj-acme-9f2. Window: 2025-04-01 00:00:00 -> 2025-04-01 23:59:59 UTC. Customer says they only made generation calls (no embeddings). I ran a quick query on the dashboard UI and it shows ~1.11M generation tokens.

jon_prod: FWIW we rolled model-slicing <-> tokenizer-change on 2025-03-28 which changed how we surface token counts in the UI (we moved to normalized_tokens for dashboards but invoices still used raw_token_count from meter-agg). Could be mismatch between normalized vs raw counts.

maria_sre: Good catch. That would explain systematic offsets but not 3x. Need to compare raw meter stream to invoice aggregation. I'll run the internal check.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2025-0421 created for acct acme-corp: amount=$3,412.60, period=2025-04-01. Metering snapshot id: ms-20250401-7.

anna_ops: Running a quick raw log dif. Use the support-cli to pull meter-agg events:
```
support-cli logs fetch --project proj-acme-9f2 --service meter-agg --start 2025-04-01T00:00:00Z --end 2025-04-02T00:00:00Z --format jsonl > /tmp/acme-meter-20250401.jsonl
jq -r '.|{ts,request_id,raw_tokens,normalized_tokens,endpoint}' /tmp/acme-meter-20250401.jsonl | head -n 20
```

omar_support: I pulled the file and attached a redacted sample in the ticket. But quick eyeballing: I see many events with raw_tokens ~= normalized_tokens*3 for entries to the /v1/generate-stream endpoint.

maria_sre: That's suspicious. Can you grep for retries and streamed_chunk_count?
```
jq 'select(.endpoint=="/v1/generate-stream") | {request_id,raw_tokens,normalized_tokens,streamed_chunks,retry_of}' /tmp/acme-meter-20250401.jsonl | grep -E 'streamed_chunks|retry_of' | head -n 50
```

omar_support: Output shows a lot of streamed_chunks: 1..6 and many entries have retry_of != null. Looks like each retry produced a new meter record without dedup.

jon_prod: That matches ENG-1129 — we recently changed stream retry semantics so frontends resend a full meter event on retry, expecting the meter-agg to deduplicate by request_id. There may be a bug where request_id changed on client retries (e.g., proxy generated new id). If request_id differs, dedupe fails and you get multiple increments.

eve_finance: If meter-agg double-counted, we'll need to compute corrected tokens for revenue impact and issue a credit. Estimate refund = (charged_tokens - corrected_tokens) * rate_per_token. Please provide an exact corrected token count.

maria_sre: I'm running a dedupe run locally against the ms-20250401-7 snapshot: algorithm: keep earliest event per trace_id OR request_id fallback. Running script now. Will post results.

(30 minutes later)

maria_sre: Results: raw billed tokens (invoice source) = 3,204,182. Deduplicated tokens (by trace_id primary, request_id fallback) = 1,103,997. Difference = 2,100,185 tokens. Looks like ~65.5% of billed tokens were duplicated due to retry/new-request_id behavior.

eve_finance: Thanks. Using rate $0.001625/token (on invoice), refund amount calc: 2,100,185 * 0.001625 = $3,412.55. Close to invoice amount. We'll need to issue a credit memo for $3,412.55 and a revrec note: Adjustment code RC-2025-04-ACME-01 with explanation "Metering dedup bug caused duplicate token billing" for audit.

omar_support: Customer wants immediate action and proof. Can we provide: 1) corrected token CSV (timestamp,trace_id,normalized_tokens) 2) short explanation and planned fix ETA?

jon_prod: ETA for fix: rolling patch to meter-agg to prefer trace_id and reject events where retry_of present but request_id differs. I can get a canary out in 48 hours and stable in 7 days. Will also add a monitor to alert if invoice vs dashboard delta > 20%.

anna_ops: I exported corrected token CSV and placed it in the secure share: s3://redwood-support/acme_corrections/INV-2025-0421-dedup.csv (redacted). CSV columns: timestamp,trace_id,request_id,normalized_tokens,endpoint.

eve_finance: I'll draft credit memo and revrec note. Please confirm the exact credit to issue and whether we should refund the invoice or apply as account credit.

omar_support: Customer asked for refund to card. We have consent in ticket SUP-7298. Please issue refund and cc support.

eve_finance: Noted. Documenting revrec note: "RC-2025-04-ACME-01: Adjust revenue recognition and issue customer credit $3,412.55 due to duplicate meter events caused by retry/new-request-id behavior in meter ingestion. Support case SUP-7298. Accounting entry: debit revenue, credit contra-revenue; link to corrected meter CSV: s3://redwood-support/acme_corrections/INV-2025-0421-dedup.csv"

maria_sre: I'll attach the dedupe script and test vectors to ENG-1129. For repro: spawn a load test that simulates 1% of requests with client-side retry that regenerates request_id and sets retry_of to the original. Verify meter-agg increments only once per trace_id. Test script snippet: 
```
# simulate original
emit_event(trace_id=abc123, request_id=req-A, raw_tokens=100, normalized_tokens=95)
# simulate retry with new request_id
emit_event(trace_id=abc123, request_id=req-B, raw_tokens=100, normalized_tokens=95, retry_of=req-A)
# expected: only count once (100 tokens)
```

jon_prod: Also adding a one-off job to backfill dedupe for recent invoices in the last 30 days where invoice vs dashboard delta > 30%.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2025-00421 created for acct acme-corp amount=$3,412.55 linked to INV-2025-0421.

omar_support: Closing loop with customer now: issuing refund $3,412.55 to card on file, attaching explanation and corrected CSV, and will follow up with timeline for permanent fix. Ticket SUP-7298 updated.

eve_finance: I'll process the refund and record revrec entry after ops confirms backfill results. Please update this thread when ENG-1129 has PR and canary results.

jon_prod: Will post PR link and canary signals. Thanks team.

omar_support: Thanks all — filing internal postmortem note in #postmortems once ENG closes root-cause.
